message.reasoning_content:
I am acting as VP of Finance to evaluate whether to approve payment for this invoice.

Three reject-level findings block payment. The total is $50 short. WidgetA, WidgetB, and GadgetX each exceed available stock. The policy requires rejecting any invoice with a reject finding.

The invoice exceeds $10,000, so I will scrutinize every finding and the risk memo in my rejection reasons. The low-level risk memo does not override the reject findings. I may also look up the vendor master to be thorough.

The line-item math confirms the $50 total mismatch. WidgetA totals 22 units at $5,450, WidgetB 18 at $8,840, and GadgetX 9 at $6,750. Subtotal is $21,040 plus $1,472.80 tax equals $22,512.80. The invoice total of $22,562.80 is exactly $50 over. I will cite each finding ID in my rejection reasons.
